description: Visual form designer for NetForms - WinForms for Windows and Linux. Edits *.Designer.cs with a canvas painted by NetForms itself, fully offline.
config.designerHostPath: Path to NetFormsDesigner.Host.dll (or the executable). Empty: the host bundled with the extension, then a NetForms checkout found above the opened file.
config.dotnetPath: The dotnet executable used to run the designer host and new projects.
config.snapToLines: Snap controls to the edges, centres and margins of their neighbours while dragging (hold Alt to move freely).
